title: P4RPC: Prevent partial UTF-8 char at end of "var=val" field:
description: - Also decode the "haveRec" fields as a subtree.

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 33810d77 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • f36ff865 - Merge branch wireshark:master into p4rpc
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22912/diffs?diff_id=1609898250&start_sha=d96e74c95fd747f2eedd39069e73ea65d2068c91)
enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

Because snprintf stops writing at the null terminator, and `wmem_alloc` (unlike `wmem_alloc0`) does not zero out the memory, this can operate on uninitialized memory, so to use snprintf correctly you must get the return value and then only call ws_utf8_truncate if the return value of snprintf is large enough to indicate that truncation occurred. Sorry for missing that before.
